comment: Two-way xfail inventory for the first-run-hostile lane (flair#1462). Each entry's marker must appear in the detector log. An unexpected FAIL, or an expected marker that does not fire, is RED and names which. Exact match is GREEN. #1459 is omitted: after #1463 the detector prints PASS for the README remedy, not FAIL (#1459). Re-add that entry only if FAIL (#1459) fires again. #1454 is omitted: after #1454 the five-state liveness machine classifies the daemon from the identity sidecar, not lsof, so stop finds the live daemon even when lsof is absent. Not required-for-merge until this array is empty.
